def: To add the same number many times to find a total.
The bottom number of a fraction; it tells how many equal parts fill one whole.
example: In 1/4, the denominator 4 means 4 fourths fill one whole.

def: One complete thing before it is cut into parts.
example: One pizza is 1 whole before you slice it.

def: Pieces that are all the same size.
example: A bar broken into 4 equal parts has 4 pieces of the same size.
